evidence.document_title: Practice Advisory for Preanesthesia Evaluation: An Updated Report by the American Society of Anesthesiologists Task Force on Preanesthesia Evaluation
evidence.population_qualifier: Patients of all ages scheduled for elective general anesthesia, regional anesthesia, or moderate or deep sedation.
evidence.setting_qualifier: Preanesthesia history, physical examination, selective testing, and consultation for elective procedures.
evidence.evidence_summary: Supports documenting pertinent medical records, patient interview, directed physical examination, airway evaluation, and lung and heart examination before elective anesthesia.
evidence.applicability_note: Exact for medical-record review, patient interview, directed airway, lung and heart examination, and selective testing including pregnancy testing when results would alter management. It is an older advisory, excludes urgent or emergency care, and does not generate tests or management.
